    # Extract all non-background cells grouped by their connected positions
    # Actually, treat each unique non-bg color as a separate object
    
    non_bg_cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    
    if not non_bg_cells:
        # Return original shape with background
        return [[bg for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    
    # Group by color
    colors = defaultdict(list)
    for r, c, val in non_bg_cells:

    # Calculate bounding boxes

        rows_list = [p[0] for p in positions]
        cols_list = [p[1] for p in positions]
        objects.append({

            'min_r': min(rows_list),
            'max_r': max(rows_list),

    min_all_c = min(all_cols)

    out_width = max_all_c - min_all_c + 1
    
    # Create output grid with 0 background

    # Place each object
